856-5776-8095-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1445-2921-4871-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2921-4871-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4352-6972-8095--112.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
4352-6972-8095--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

2921-4364-7917.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2921-4364-7917.description:
Declare Aurelia and Seluma as attackers. Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Aurelia.
Deal combat damage using Seluma. Seluma triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6157-7892.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-6157-7892.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

549-6797-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-6797-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Phantom Train.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

5086-5183-5231-6753-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6753-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

1806-2060-5147-6774-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Loading Zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

277-774-907.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Selesnya Sanctuary's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
277-774-907.notes: After gaining an arbitrarily large amount of mana, you may repeat the loop choosing Tiller Engine's other mode to tap any number of nonland permanents opponents control.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-4771-5660.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4668-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1084-7151.description:
Cast High Perfect Morcant either from your hand or the command zone by paying {2}{B}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When High Perfect Morcant enters, its first ability triggers, causing each opponent to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature they control.
Flourishing Defenses triggers for each counter placed this way. Resolve the first trigger, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters, High Perfect Morcant's first ability triggers, causing each opponent to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature they control.
Repeat from step 3.
1084-7151.notes: You can resolve all additional Flourishing Defense triggers to create additional tokens. The tokens can also be tapped using High Perfect Morcant to proliferate. This loop can be restarted by having any Elf enter under your control.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

3940-7117.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction.
Haze of Rage's storm ability triggers, copying Haze of Rage for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rages, giving creatures you control +1/+0 until end of turn for each Haze of Rage and returning the original Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

1114-3129-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1114-3129-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Wrenn and Realmbreaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

3750-6898-7025.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
3750-6898-7025.description:
Declare a creature as an attacker, triggering Avatar Roku, adding six {R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Electro.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
3750-6898-7025.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you can activate Avatar Roku infinitely to give your red creatures infinite power.
Once you have infinite mana, you may kill Electro and use its triggered ability to deal infinite damage to target player.

1170-1329-1492-4885.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-4885.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater
attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes

81-1978-5143.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat

431-851-4365-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-4365-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1494-3017-6822-6838.description:
If you have more than three cards in hand, activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have three or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Doctor Octopus triggers, causing you to draw at least five cards.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4853-6798-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
4853-6798-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

38-301-1768.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-1768.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Putrid Goblin.
Repeat.

645-1267-2921-3908.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2921-3908.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

2736-3140-6085.description:
Activate Zedruu the Greathearted by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
2736-3140-6085.notes: When the opponent loses the game, you regain control of Altanak, and may repeat this combo targeting another opponent if mana allows.

1940-4050-4191-5010.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding one mana of any color.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Liliana trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Liliana trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

4598-4863-5195.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Revolutionist.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1308-1651-1737-4715.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Prized Statue.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures and/or Prized Statue tokens, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1947-4396-5220.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Reckless Barbarian on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reckless Barbarian from the top of your library by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1367-2686-3189-4181-5079.notablePrerequisites:
Hellcarver Demon does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Hellcarver Demon.
Your life total is at least 2.
1367-2686-3189-4181-5079.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, searching your library and graveyard for any Barren Glory, Nexus of Fate, Tormented Thoughts, and any two other cards, exiling all other cards from your graveyard and library, and then placing the remaining cards on top of your library in the order mentioned previously and losing half your life, rounded up.
Proceed to your combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent with Hellcarver Demon.
Hellcarver Demon triggers, causing you to sacrifice all other permanents you control, discard your hand, exile the top six cards of your library, and allows you to cast Barren Glory, Tormented Thoughts, and Nexus of Fate from exile without paying their mana costs.
Resolve Tormented Thoughts, sacrificing Hellcarver Demon and causing a player to discard a number of cards equal to Hellcarver Demon's power.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, taking an extra turn after this one and shuffling Nexus of Fate into your library.
Proceed to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.

1872-5140.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

95-5080.description: Cast Maddening Cacophony with kicker by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each opponent to mill their library due to Bruvac.
